title: BAYESIAN WEAKS-TO-STRONG FROM TEXT CLASSIFICATION TO GENERATION
reasoning: The paper focuses on an alignment methodology (WeakS-to-Strong) using Bayesian principles. Its evaluations are conducted on standard tasks like science exam questions (SciQ), slot-filling (SLURP), and commonsense reasoning (CosmosQA), none of which involve benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, or ethics specifically.
